plugins.name: kaizen
plugins.description: Eight standalone skills for building an app with an agent: app-settle and design-settle decide what the app is and how it looks; build-flow, docs-format, ui-build, db-ops and logic-build carry the build rules; norms-help prints help. On Claude Code and the Antigravity CLI a hook prints ten working rules into every session; it never refuses or blocks, and a repo's CLAUDE.md waives or adds to them.
